title: z7w's property tests made internal/cli the short gate's long pole
body:
internal/cli is now the per-tick gate's slowest package under -short: 101-136s here.

Most of that is z7w's Hegel properties:
- TestPBTFlagsParseInAnyOrder: 28s
- TestPBTWatchAlertsAHoldExactlyWhenTheRunHoldsIt: 19s
- TestPBTExitCodeAgreesWithTheDocumentState: 18s
- four more at 3-9s each

CI's full cli suite went from 58s to 112s.

In an epic whose purpose is a faster gate, the property tests should take a smaller example budget under -short, keeping the full budget in the non-short suite, so the gate's floor is not set by a test-generation budget.
evidence: go test -short -count=1 -json ./internal/cli/ (elapsed per test); CI packages job internal/cli 58.254s (run 37704846560) vs 112.381s (run 37716696321)
